description:
List top keywords of a property ranked by a chosen metric with period-over-period comparison. Accepts date range presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to). Optional filters: country, device, search_type (web), position_min/max, branded (true|false), tags (array of tag names from list_tags — keeps only keywords carrying any of those tags). position_min/position_max keep only keywords whose current-period average position falls in that range, applied regardless of sort (e.g. quick-wins 4-10, striking-distance 11-20); not combinable with country/device yet. tags cannot be combined with branded. Returns all four metrics per keyword (position is always present), a summary scoped by the same filters as the rows — so "this tag / this position bucket did X clicks" is the summary total, not the sum of the returned head rows — and cursor pagination. summary.branded_breakdown splits those same filtered totals into branded vs non-branded; it is null when the property has no Brand tag or when a branded filter is already set. Pass property ID or sc-domain URL from list_properties. Each keyword carries search_volume: Google Ads average monthly searches in the country filter if one is given, else in the search-volume market of the property; value is null unless state is ok or zero (not_fetched = not looked up yet), as_of is the month it was fetched. Each keyword also carries traffic_value_eur: an estimated equivalent ad spend, i.e. its current-period clicks priced at the Google Ads low top-of-page bid of that same country, in EUR; 0 when Google has a volume but no bid, null when it has no volume (state not ok or zero). An estimate of what the clicks would cost as ads, not revenue.

Cost: 5 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Top 25 keywords by clicks over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_28_days","sortBy":"clicks","limit":25}
```

device.description: Device slice. Omit for all devices.

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.

tags.description: Keyword tag names from list_tags. Keeps only keywords carrying any of these tags. Cannot be combined with branded.

name: get_top_keywords

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

summary.description: Totals over the same filtered keyword set as the rows.

title: Top keywords
